text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gaaaah! It's been a while since I've been this mad! I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But, well... It was also fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right... Racing is fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Running itself just feels good. It's like I
become
one with the wind and my mind
is completely free.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There I am, just running. There's nothing
else but
that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but... it makes me so
happy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think I love myself the most when I'm
running.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Same here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A runn'n City is the City I love most. And
as for
myself...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever loved myself more
than I do
right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's good.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yukino. I'll see you
later!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Yukino Bijin!
You were
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You're the best, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yu-ki-no! Yu-ki-no! Yu-ki-no!
Yu-ki-no!
Yu-ki-no! Yu-ki-no!
Yu-ki-no! Yu-ki-no!
Yu-ki-no!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers for Yukino Bijin swirl around her
like a
flurry of snow, drowning out all
other sounds.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Golly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The applause continue on, each wave
hitting the
turf just as hard as the last.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
D'ya think I'm closer to being a city girl
now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not stopp'n here! I'm back and I
wanna be
bigger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So I've gotta keep push'n forward.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heheh! I'm glad t'hear it!
choice_data_list: I'll stick with you to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt, bzzzzt.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Mifuyu...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu passed her badge test!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That means she's one step closer to
mak'n her
dream of skat'n in an
international competition
come true!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't b'lieve it... We both got closer to
realiz'n
our dreams today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna r'member this day forever!
